apps.name: My Store
apps.shortDescription: Public independent Android APK marketplace powered by GitHub Releases.
apps.description: My Store is a privacy-respecting, independent Android APK marketplace built for distributing and updating public releases directly from GitHub Releases. Every APK download uses HTTPS, verifies its SHA-256 checksum against the trusted catalog, and hands off installation to Android's official PackageInstaller with full user confirmation.
features: HTTPS-only APK downloads with real-time progress
apps.releaseNotes: Initial signed release of My Store.
permissions: INTERNET — Fetch app catalog and download APKs over HTTPS
REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES — Hand off verified APKs to Android's package installer
POST_NOTIFICATIONS — Notify when downloads complete or updates are available
